notes.content: The Health, Medicine, and Society (HMS) program integrates coursework relevant to the field of medicine from across many disciplines. It is meant to serve students interested in a wide range of career paths, from medical provider (physician, nurse, physician assistant, midwife) to health care administrator, from public health to healthcare policy. The program is built upon the conviction that questions about health and healthcare can only be meaningfully addressed by integrating different disciplinary perspectives. Thus, it provides a framework for navigating a wide range of classes ensuring both breadth of exposure and depth of perspective. The following are the LOWER DIVISION REQUIREMENTS for this major. Please visit the catalog for all requirements for Health, Medicine, and Society, B.A.
